name: Oschophoria
summary: The vintage procession of the vine-branch bearers from Athens to the shrine of Athena Skiras — two youths in women's dress at its head, remembering the ruse of Theseus' homecoming crew.
testimonia: Plutarch, Theseus 22–23 (the procession and its Thesean founding)
Deubner, Attische Feste (1932) 142–147 (the day disputed, near the Pyanepsia)
